cross_copy_assumption: These three closely matching 180-coordinate copies carry the same intended text. The readable common candidate selects witnessed alternatives by ordinary-word context; it is not a coordinate-majority rule.

earlier_repository_candidates.interpretation: The stop-order copies and B2 predate this edition as unreviewed readable screen candidates. B1 had a badly degraded 275-coordinate OCR candidate; the source has274. This is source correction and a priced edition, not a first historical decipherment claim.
